notes: threshold_mode: set to 'manual' to override the model's trained threshold. ensemble_weight: controls the balance between new (retrained K=8) and old (original K=16) models. Value is the new model's weight (0.0-1.0), old model gets the remainder. Example: 0.55 means 55% new + 45% old. Higher = trust new model more, Lower = trust old model more.
